question: Can the unchanged bounded-hold recovery controller complete the fresh declared population through a supervisor whose lifetime and terminal publication do not depend on the interactive tool caller?
reason: R10U passed the complete 64-stage 229-test gate and completed both native children, but the original supervisor disappeared without replay, final-audit or terminal-publication receipts. Separate unchanged native replays and finite measurements pass for both retained reports. The original interruption cause remains unknown; memory pressure and caller lifetime are risks to test, not established causes.

limits.wall_basis: The physical horizon gains at most 240 commands. The child wall ceiling gains a bounded 240 seconds over R10S; this changes no solver timing, controller threshold or physical result criterion.

conditional_hold_rule: Preserve every conditional hold, readiness, dwell, ownership and fresh-memory rule in the bound predecessor design.
allowed_changes: Implement a durable outer host that starts the real production supervisor with explicit source, runtime and invocation bindings, captures original stdout and stderr to durable files, and retains its original terminal process receipt.

Keep the full existing launch-relationship and operation-lock ownership chain. A disconnected interactive caller must not destroy a healthy owned supervisor; explicit stop must terminate only its exact owned process tree. Never automatically restart or retry a consumed attempt.

Retain append-only stage-start and stage-end records for physical children, replays and final audit, plus their process identities and source/runtime bindings. Missing completion remains incomplete, never recovered into a success receipt.

After the original full child envelope is durably written and verified, release bulky report objects before the next child or replay. Preserve immutable raw reports and exact envelope hashes; keep all launch, termination, health and publication checks.
Implement distinct R10V population, source keys and route identity without changing native control behavior or the physical and measurement contracts.
qualification_requirements: Preserve all existing applicable 64-stage 229-test checks. Add actual host lifecycle and bounded-memory retention controls, declare the exact resulting graph and dependency key, and run it completely before any physical world.

Use actual short-lived zero-world subprocesses to test interactive-parent loss, normal completion, nonzero exit, deadline expiry, explicit owned cancellation, absent or malformed terminal records, crossed PID or invocation identity, source drift, duplicate launch and duplicate publication. Exercise the real host entrypoint rather than only mocked API calls.

Demonstrate that source remains unchanged, the real operation lock stays owned until child cleanup, and unrelated processes survive the cancellation controls. Retain both success and negative-control records.

Test releasing in-memory child payloads only after their original durable bindings verify; corruption, missing envelope or failed launch relationship must still refuse. The supervisor must publish exactly one terminal result from original files.

Run the complete real final auditor on the exposed pair in a separately labeled diagnostic or explicit synthetic declaration projection. Preserve all receipt provenance; do not fabricate an original supervisor or retrofit the consumed R10U attempt.

Declare bounded host and audit limits before qualification based on measurements. Do not change 1740-second physical-child limits, readiness dwell, solver timing, step budgets, telemetry or evaluator thresholds.
Require a clean pushed prospective freeze and fresh one-use execution authority for the new pair. No physical resumption, baseline reuse, automatic retry or additional R10U branch is permitted.

development_coverage.coverage_adequacy: Two independently replayed R10U reports satisfy every unchanged finite-task predicate but their original supervisor and audit receipts are missing. One fresh matched pair is the minimum complete population that covers both original-role launch, report retention, independent replay, final audit and publication through the repaired workflow. Exposed reports qualify only interfaces; they supply no baseline or prerequisite result. Three distinct kicked branch diagnostics remain conditional on this new pair.
development_coverage.if_pair_not_valid_positive: Close the R10V chain and retain the attempt. No later R10V physical diagnostic may launch.
development_coverage.additional_negative_rule: Retain every result once. Remaining predeclared branch diagnostics may complete for coverage; any invalid or negative prevents held-out declaration under this design.
development_coverage.held_out_precondition: All five fresh development cells must be valid finite positives under their original workflow, with the required hold/direct branches. Then declare a separate fresh held-out population, qualification, one-use authority, finite decision and release-gate adoption.
